model: VULCAN-2D measured-SET-conditioned full cycle with effective Poole-Frenkel-like HRS transport

data.protocol: paired 0 to -1.7 to 0 V DC RESET

rejected_cycles.reason: RESET cycle does not have separable LRS and HRS envelopes
RESET cycle does not have separable LRS and HRS envelopes

prediction_protocol.validation: leave one complete S_i-to-R_i pair out of every fitted SET transfer, HRS curvature and HRS endpoint law
prediction_protocol.target_inputs: target measured SET trace and target RESET voltage protocol

scope.fit_level: beta_PF is shared within one gate/protocol group; A_HRS varies between cycles
scope.not_identified: no trap energy, dielectric constant or unique microscopic transport mechanism is inferred without temperature data

claim_scope.paired_order: S_i is the measured operation immediately before R_i
claim_scope.reset_target_leakage: target RESET current is not a model input
claim_scope.set_exposure: integral |I| dV is a voltage-domain proxy; without sweep time it is not an absolute charge or energy
claim_scope.physical_interpretation: SET history contains statistical information about the following RESET starting conductance; correlation does not identify a unique atomistic migration species
claim_scope.hrs_endpoint: within a fixed gate and DC protocol, final HRS is represented by a log-domain attractor distribution rather than a fixed HRS/LRS ratio
claim_scope.hrs_endpoint_generalization: the attractor may be used only at its fitted gate and protocol; cross-gate changes can include batch effects
claim_scope.remaining_limit: the SET trace is experimental input, so this is a measured-SET-conditioned full cycle, not a fully autonomous SET simulator
claim_scope.reset_state: observable fraction of resettable conductance between identified cycle LRS/HRS envelopes
claim_scope.reset_drive: reconstructed average h-BN field only; no terminal-voltage blend
claim_scope.gate_dependence: none in the h-BN RESET survival law; gate enters through the measured transistor and the conditioned initial state
claim_scope.time_limitation: quasi-static voltage-ramp identification; no physical time constant
claim_scope.microscopic_limitation: state is not uniquely assigned to metal ions or boron vacancies
claim_scope.absolute_reset_boundary: G_LRS is predicted from the preceding measured SET trace; the effective HRS amplitude is supplied by a fixed-gate, fixed-protocol endpoint distribution
claim_scope.endpoint_leakage: strict validation excludes the target endpoint amplitude from its protocol distribution
claim_scope.validated_gate_range: the transition law spans the 0.9--1.3 V interpolation range; the effective HRS curvature is currently validated at 1.1 V
claim_scope.remaining_endpoint_limitation: the endpoint distribution is protocol-specific and can include cycle-history or batch effects
claim_scope.hrs_transport: effective V_hBN*exp(beta_PF*sqrt(V_hBN)) curvature fitted within one gate and DC RESET protocol
claim_scope.hrs_transport_limit: beta_PF is a compact voltage-domain coefficient; it is not a trap energy or dielectric constant without temperature data
claim_scope.transport_model_selection: the effective PF-like curve is selected for predictive curvature; the available single-temperature data do not prove a unique microscopic conduction mechanism

verdict.remaining_limits: measured SET is still an input; no physical-time constant or unique ionic/vacancy species is identified
